095public sealed abstract class CustomTagletBase implements Taglet
096    permits OtherFileTagletBase, SimpleTagletBase, AnchorTaglet, AuthorTaglet,
097        HRefTaglet, ImageTaglet, InspiredTaglet, ModifiedTaglet, NoteTaglet,
098        ThanksTaglet, ToDoTaglet, UnderlineTaglet

101    ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
102        \*---------------*/
103    /**
104     *  <p>{@summary The common base class for all custom taglet in this
105     *  library.}</p>
106     *
107     *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
108     *  @version $Id: CustomTagletBase.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
109     *  @since 0.25.2
110     */
111    @ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: CustomTagletBase.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
112    @API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.25.2" )
113    protected final class CustomTagScanner extends DocTreeScanner<String,Element>
114    {
115            /*--------------*\
116        ====** Constructors **=================================================
117            \*--------------*/
118        /**
119         *  {@summary Creates a new instance of {@code CustomTagScanner}.}
120         */
121        public CustomTagScanner() { /* Just exists */ }
122
123            /*---------*\
124        ====** Methods **======================================================
125            \*---------*/
126        /**
127         *  {@inheritDoc}
128         */
129        @Override
130        public final String reduce( final String r1, final String r2 )
131        {
132            final var retValue = mapFromNull( r2, EMPTY_STRING ).concat( mapFromNull( r1, EMPTY_STRING ) );
133
134            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
135            return retValue;
136        }   //  reduce()
137
138        /**
139         *  {@inheritDoc}
140         */
141        @Override
142        public String visitDocRoot( final DocRootTree node, final Element element )
143        {
144            final var elementUtils = getDocletEnvironment().getElementUtils();
145            final var pkg = elementUtils.getPackageOf( element );
146            final var pkgName = pkg.getQualifiedName().toString();
147
148            var depth = pkgName.isEmpty() ? 0 : splitString( pkgName, '.' ).length;
149
150            //---* Module counts as an additional folder level *---------------
151            final var module = elementUtils.getModuleOf( element );
152            if( nonNull( module ) && !module.isUnnamed() ) ++depth;
153
154            final var retValue = depth == 0
155                ? "."
156                : join( "/", nCopies( depth, ".." ) );
157
158            //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
159            return retValue;
160        }   //  visitDocRoot()
161
162        /**
163         *  {@inheritDoc}
164         */
165        @Override
166        public final String visitIndex( final IndexTree node, final Element element )
167        {
168            final var retValue = super.visitIndex( node, element );
169
170            //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
171            return retValue;
172        }   //  visitIndex()
173
174        /**
175         *  {@inheritDoc}
176         */
177        @Override
178        public String visitLink( final LinkTree node, final Element element )
179        {
180            final var tag = node.getKind() == DocTree.Kind.LINK ? "code" : "span";
181            final var reference = scan( node.getReference(), element );
182            final var label = scan( node.getLabel(), element );
183            final String retValue;
184            if( isNotEmpty( label ) )
185            {
186                retValue = reduce( "<%1$s>%2$s</%1$s>".formatted( tag, label ), "<%1$s>%2$s</%1$s>".formatted( "code", reference ) );
187            }
188            else
189            {
190                retValue = "<%1$s>%2$s</%1$s>".formatted( tag, reference );
191            }
192
193            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
194            return retValue;
195        }   //  visitLink()
196
197        /**
198         *  {@inheritDoc}
199         */
200        @Override
201        public final String visitLiteral( final LiteralTree node, final Element element )
202        {
203            final var body = escapeHTML( scan( node.getBody(), element ) );
204            final var tag = node.getKind() == DocTree.Kind.CODE ? "code" : "span";
205            final var retValue = "<%1$s>%2$s</%1$s>".formatted( tag, body );
206
207            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
208            return retValue;
209        }   //  visitLiteral()
210
211        /**
212         *  {@inheritDoc}
213         */
214        @Override
215        public final String visitReference( final ReferenceTree node, final Element element )
216        {
217            /*
218             *  We do not support {@link} and {@linkplain} inside our custom
219             *  tags.
220             */
221            final var signature = node.getSignature();
222            final var retValue = signature.startsWith( "#" )
223                ? signature.substring( 1 )
224                : signature.replace( '#', '.' );
225
226            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
227            return retValue;
228        }   //  visitReference()
229
230        /**
231         *  {@inheritDoc}
232         */
233        @Override
234        public final String visitSystemProperty( final SystemPropertyTree node, final Element element )
235        {
236            final var retValue = "<code>%s</code>".formatted( node.getPropertyName() );
237
238            //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
239            return retValue;
240        }   //  visitSystemProperty()
241
242        /**
243         *  {@inheritDoc}
244         */
245        @Override
246        public final String visitText( final TextTree node, final Element unused )
247        {
248            final var retValue = node.getBody();
249
250            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
251            return retValue;
252        }   //  visitText()
253
254        /**
255         *  {@inheritDoc}
256         */
257        @Override
258        public String visitUnknownInlineTag( final UnknownInlineTagTree node, final Element element )
259        {
260            final var tagName = node.getTagName();
261            BiFunction<List<? extends DocTree>,Element,String> function = m_TagFunctions.get( tagName );
262            final String retValue;
263            if( isNull( function ) )
264            {
265                printf( ERROR, "Unknown Custom Tag: %s", tagName );
266                retValue = "[{@%s} unknown]".formatted( tagName );
267            }
268            else
269            {
270                retValue = function.apply( List.of( node ), element );
271            }
272
273            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
274            return retValue;
275        }   //  visitUnknownInlineTag()
276    }
277    //  class CustomTagScanner

337     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new instance of {@code CustomTagletBase}.}</p>

340     *  @param  isInlineTag {@code true} if the tag is an inline tag,

342     *  @param  allowedLocations    The locations that are allowed for the tag
343     *      that is implemented by this taglet.
344     */
345    protected CustomTagletBase( final String name, final boolean isInlineTag, final Location... allowedLocations )
346    {
347        m_Name = requireNotEmptyArgument( name, "name" );
348        m_IsInlineTag = isInlineTag;
349
350        m_AllowedLocations.addAll( asList( requireNonNullArgument( allowedLocations, "allowedLocations" ) ) );

358    /**
359     *  <p>{@summary Composes an HTML {@code <href>} link from the given
360     *  {@code url} string and contents.}</p>
361     *
362     *  @param  url The link target.
363     *  @param  contents    The link text.
364     *  @return The {@code <href>}.
365     */
366    protected final String composeLink( final String url, final String contents )
367    {
368        final var retValue = format( "<a href=\"%1$s\">%2$s</a>", url, contents );
369
370        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
371        return retValue;
372    }   //  composeLink()
373
374    /**
375     *  <p>{@summary Composes a
376     *  {@link Name}
377     *  instance from the given String.}</p>
378     *
379     *  @param  name    The name value.
380     *  @return The {@code Name} instance.
381     */
382    private final Name composeName( final CharSequence name )
383    {
384        final var retValue = getDocletEnvironment().getElementUtils().getName( name );
385
386        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
387        return retValue;
388    }   //  composeName()
389
390    /**
391     *  Finds the end of a tag in the given text.
392     *
393     *  @param  text    The text.
394     *  @return The position for closing bracket for the tag, or -1 if there is
395     *      no closing bracket, or the text is not a tag.
396     */
397    private final int findEnd( final String text )
398    {
399        var retValue = -1;
400        if( text.startsWith( INLINE_TAG_LeadIn) )
401        {
402            var level = 1;
403            retValue = 2;
404            while( (level > 0) && (retValue < text.length()) )
405            {
406                switch( text.charAt( retValue ) )
407                {
408                    case '}' -> { if( --level > 0 ) ++retValue; }
409                    case '{' -> { if( (retValue++ < text.length()) && (text.charAt( retValue ) == '@') ) ++level; }
410                    default -> ++retValue;
411                }
412            }
413            if( level > 0 ) retValue = -1;
414        }
415
416        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
417        return retValue;
418    }   //  findEnd()
419

429    /**
430     *  <p>{@summary Forces the initialisation of the inline tags.}</p>
431     *  <p>For some unknown reason it may happen that the inline tags are not
432     *  yet registered in
433     *  {@link #m_TagFunctions},
434     *  causing an &quot;{@code error: unknown tag: …}&quot; message when used
435     *  within another custom tag.</p>
436     */
437    protected final void forceInit()
438    {
439        List.of( new AnchorTaglet(), new FALSETaglet(), new HRefTaglet(), new IgnoreTaglet(),
440            new IncludeTaglet(), new NULLTaglet(), new TRUETaglet(), new UnderlineTaglet() )
441            .stream()
442            .filter( t -> t.isInlineTag() ) // Just because of paranoia …
443            .filter( t -> !m_TagFunctions.containsKey( t.getName() ) )
444            .forEach( t -> t.init( getDocletEnvironment(), getDoclet() ) );
445    }   //  forceInit()

497    /**
498     *  <p>{@summary Parses the given text for a known inline tag and returns
499     *  the relevant
500     *  {@link DocTree}
501     *  instance, or an
502     *  {@link UnknownInlineTagTree}
503     *  instance if the tag is not known (or it is a custom tag).}</p>
504     *
505     *  @param  text    The text that should be a tag.
506     *  @return The matching {@code DocTree} instance.
507     */
508    private DocTree identifyTag( final String text )
509    {
510        final var factory = getDocTreeFactory();
511
512        //---* Get the tag *---------------------------------------------------
513        final var blankPos = text.indexOf( ' ' );
514        final var endPos = findEnd( text );
515        final var tag = text.substring( 2, blankPos > NOT_FOUND ? blankPos : endPos );
516        final var body = blankPos == NOT_FOUND ? EMPTY_STRING : text.substring( blankPos + 1, endPos );
517        final var contents = factory.newTextTree( body );
518
519        //---* Create the DocTree *--------------------------------------------
520        final DocTree retValue = switch( tag )
521        {
522            //noinspection DataFlowIssue
523            case null -> factory.newTextTree( EMPTY_STRING );
524            case "code" -> factory.newCodeTree( contents );
525            case "docRoot" -> factory.newDocRootTree();
526            case "index" -> factory.newIndexTree( contents, List.of() );
527            case "inheritDoc" -> factory.newTextTree( EMPTY_STRING );
528            case "literal" -> factory.newLiteralTree( contents );
529            case "snippet" -> factory.newSnippetTree( List.of(), contents );
530            case "summary" -> contents;
531            case "systemProperty" -> factory.newSystemPropertyTree( composeName( body ) );
532            default -> factory.newUnknownInlineTagTree( composeName( tag ), List.of( contents ) );
533        };
534
535        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
536        return retValue;
537    }   //  identifyTag()
538
539    /**
540     *  {@inheritDoc}
541     */
542    @Override
543    public final void init( final DocletEnvironment env, final Doclet doclet )
544    {
545        Taglet.super.init( env, doclet );
546        if( doclet instanceof StandardDoclet standardDoclet )
547        {
548            m_Doclet = standardDoclet;
549        }
550        else
551        {
552            printf( ERROR, "Wrong Doclet implementation: %s%nThis custom taglet work only with '%s'", doclet.getClass().getName(), StandardDoclet.class.getName() );
553            throw new Error();
554        }
555        m_DocletEnvironment = env;
556        if( m_IsInlineTag ) m_TagFunctions.computeIfAbsent( getName(), _ -> this::toString );
557        customInit();
558    }   //  init()

566    /**
567     *  <p>{@summary Parses the given tags for a name and an email
568     *  address.}</p>
569     *  <p>The tag is prefixed with the tag text, and name and email address
570     *  are separated by a hyphen (&quot;&#x2d;&quot; or &amp;#x2d;),
571     *  surrounded by blanks.</p>
572     *
573     *  @param  tags    The tags.
574     *  @return The formatted output.
575     */
576    protected final String parseNameAndEmail( final Collection<? extends DocTree> tags )
577    {
578        final var prefix = format( "@%s", getName() );
579        final var prefixLen = prefix.length();
580        final var retValue = tags.stream()
581            .map( Object::toString )
582            .map( s -> s.substring( prefixLen ).trim() )
583            .map( s ->
584            {
585                final var pos = s.indexOf( " - " );
586                if( pos < 0 )
587                {
588                    if( s.endsWith( " -" ) ) return s.substring( 0, s.length() - 1 ).trim();
589                    return s.trim();
590                }
591
592                final var emailAddress = s.substring( pos + 3 ).trim();
593                if( emailAddress.isEmpty() ) return s.substring( 0, pos ).trim();
594
595                final var buffer = s.substring( 0, pos ).trim() +
596                    " (<a href=\"mailto:" +
597                    emailAddress +
598                    "\">" +
599                    emailAddress +
600                    "</a>)";
601                return buffer;
602            } )
603            .collect( joining( ", ") );
604
605        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
606        return retValue;
607    }   //  parseNameAndEmail()
608
609    /**
610     *  Parses the given text for some inline tags and returns the respective
611     *  {@link DocTree}
612     *  instances.
613     *
614     *  @param  text    The text to parse.
615     *  @return The {@code DocTree} instances.
616     */
617    protected final List<? extends DocTree> parseText( final String text )
618    {
619        final var factory = getDocTreeFactory();
620        final List<DocTree> retValue = new ArrayList<>();
621        var pos = text.indexOf( INLINE_TAG_LeadIn );
622        if( pos == NOT_FOUND )
623        {
624            retValue.add( factory.newTextTree( text ) );
625        }
626        else
627        {
628            var remainder = text;
629            ScanLoop: while( pos > NOT_FOUND )
630            {
631                if( pos > 0 )
632                {
633                    retValue.add( factory.newTextTree( remainder.substring( 0, pos ) ) );
634                    remainder = remainder.substring( pos );
635                }
636                var end = findEnd( remainder );
637                if( end == NOT_FOUND )
638                {
639                    retValue.add( factory.newTextTree( remainder ) );
640                    //noinspection UnusedAssignment
641                    pos = NOT_FOUND;
642                    break ScanLoop;
643                }
644                retValue.add( identifyTag( remainder.substring( 0, ++end ) ) );
645                remainder = remainder.substring( end );
646                pos = remainder.indexOf( INLINE_TAG_LeadIn );
647            }   //  ScanLoop:
648            if( !remainder.isEmpty() ) retValue.add( factory.newTextTree( remainder ) );
649        }
650
651        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
652        return retValue;
653    }   //  parseText()

666    /**

672     *  @param  message The message to be printed.
673     */
674    protected final void print( final Kind kind, final Element element, final String message )
675    {
676        m_Doclet.getReporter().print( kind, element, message );
677    }   //  print()
